skills.name: Fishing
skills.description: Fish into the unknown for broad discoveries, or build a pond whose surrounding biome shapes what the water brings back.

skills.name: Woodland Tending
skills.description: Tend placeable trees. The landscape around each tree shapes the discoveries it produces before it rests and recovers.

skills.name: Mining
skills.description: Placed stone formations will reveal discoveries shaped by their surroundings. (Coming with the mountain update.)
